name: Algorithm Visualizer
tagline: Interactive visual learning platform for sorting and searching algorithms
highlights: Led a team of 2 and improved delivery efficiency by 20%, finishing two weeks early.
Built step-by-step sorting and searching visualizations with real-time comparisons between algorithms.
Added playback controls to adjust visualization speed and replay runs for deeper understanding.
Let users configure array size, data distribution, and algorithm type to test different scenarios.
Used color-coding and live highlights to show comparisons, swaps, and key decision points.

name: StudyNotion
tagline: Full-stack edtech platform with secure auth, course management, and payments
highlights: Implemented JWT + OTP-based authentication and secure password flows for students and instructors.
Designed a responsive, modern UI with personalized dashboards, search, wishlist, cart, and course detail pages.
Built instructor course management to create, update, and organize multimedia lessons and pricing.
Integrated Razorpay for smooth checkout and optimized backend workflows to reduce load times by ~30%.
Used Cloudinary for scalable media storage and Redux for robust client-side state management.

name: Journal App
tagline: Production-style Spring Boot backend with auth, caching, analytics, and cloud deployment
highlights: Built secure journaling APIs with JWT auth, role-based access control, and Google OAuth login.
Implemented sentiment analysis and weather-based greetings with Redis caching for fast responses.
Exposed comprehensive Swagger/OpenAPI docs for all public, user, journal, and admin endpoints.
Scheduled background jobs for weekly sentiment email reports and cache refresh operations.
Containerized the backend with Docker and wired it for MongoDB Atlas and Redis in cloud environments.

name: Live Location Tracker
tagline: Real-time geolocation tracking dashboard using WebSockets and interactive maps
highlights: Streams user geolocation updates over Socket.io and renders them on an interactive Leaflet.js map.
Built a real-time dashboard for tracking multiple users simultaneously with smooth marker animations.
Handled disconnects, reconnections, and stale sessions to keep the map state consistent.
Structured the backend to be extensible for alerts, geofencing, and historical replay features.

name: Briefly-Legal
tagline: AI-powered legal document analysis with NLP and machine learning
highlights: Automates legal document review by extracting key clauses, risks, and insights from contracts.
Uses reading-comprehension models trained on SQuAD and CUAD datasets to answer questions on top of uploaded agreements.
Includes a T5-based paraphrasing model to rewrite complex legal language into clearer summaries.
Runs sentiment analysis with TextBlob to flag potentially risky or unfavorable clauses.
Connects a Next.js frontend to Flask ML services and ships with Docker Compose for one-command local deployment.
